Duy Beni is a high school drama series that follows Ekim, a determined young girl whose life changes dramatically after her best friend is seriously injured in a mysterious hit-and-run accident. Driven by a desire for justice, Ekim transfers to an elite private school where she suspects the truth is being hidden behind wealth, power, and privilege. As she navigates a world divided between scholarship students and the rich elite, she uncovers dark secrets, bullying, and dangerous lies that threaten to destroy lives. Along the way, complicated relationships begin to form, especially with Kanat, a seemingly cold student with his own hidden struggles. As tensions rise and truths come to light, Ekim is forced to confront not only the system around her but also her own fears and emotions. Blending suspense, emotional intensity, romance, and social commentary, Duy Beni explores themes of justice, inequality, trust, and the courage to speak the truth.
